entities.name: Ines Okoro
entities.short_summary: A freelance guide and bodyguard walks newcomers through the drowned districts for a day rate.
entities.description:
A freelance guide and bodyguard walks newcomers through the drowned districts for a day rate. She knows which stairwells flood at high tide, which checkpoints take bribes, and which ones log them.

Ines keeps her rates posted on a cracked placard and her knife where clients can see it. She sells her clients' routes to a Kestrel handler to keep her own record clean.
entities.public_truth: She takes any client who pays the day rate and gets them where they are going alive.
entities.lived_detail: Ines counts exits out loud when she enters a room, a habit she says is for the client's benefit.
entities.hidden_truth: She sells her clients' routes to a Kestrel handler to keep her own record clean.
entities.consequence: A client she trusts could cost her the handler's protection.
entities.goal: Earn enough to buy her sister's debt back from Helix
entities.dependency: Steady clients and the handler's silence
entities.current_pressure: Kestrel wants more routes than she has clients
entities.next_action: Find a client worth walking to the docks
reaction_conditions: Respects people who ask before they act
Leaves anyone who bargains after the job
knowledge_limits: Knows streets and checkpoints, not corporate plans
entities.image_prompt: Cyberpunk RPG concept art for Ines Okoro. A wiry freelance guide in a patched, rain-dark shell stands beneath flickering station floodlights, a cracked rate placard slung at her hip and a knife worn openly, counting exits with a glance while commuters stream past a flooded stairwell.

entities.name: Pell Sato
entities.short_summary: A platform vendor sells stim patches, ration bars, and dry socks from a converted ticket kiosk.
entities.description:
A platform vendor sells stim patches, ration bars, and dry socks from a converted ticket kiosk. Pell buys back anything sealed and unopened, and anything else for a coin.

The kiosk's old fare screen now lists prices in three currencies and one grudge.
entities.public_truth: Pell's prices are fair until a train is late.
entities.lived_detail: Pell wraps every sale in transit-map paper from routes that no longer run.
entities.goal: Keep the kiosk open through the next corporate sweep
entities.dependency: Commuters and the station's dead corridors
entities.current_pressure: Helix wants the kiosk's spot for a clinic kiosk
entities.next_action: Restock stim patches before the night rush
knowledge_limits: Knows the station and its trains, not the city above
entities.image_prompt: Cyberpunk RPG concept art for Pell Sato. A cheerful platform vendor leans out of a converted ticket kiosk at Black Rain Station, its old fare screen glowing with prices in three currencies, strips of stim patches and stacked ration bars wrapped in faded transit-map paper.

entities.name: Dex Marlowe
entities.short_summary: A bunkhouse keeper rents capsule bunks and hot noodles in the station's dead corridors.
entities.description:
A bunkhouse keeper rents capsule bunks and hot noodles in the station's dead corridors. Dex's bunkhouse is off every current map, which is why people pay for it.

A bowl of noodles comes with every night, and questions cost extra.
entities.public_truth: Dex never asks a sleeper's name and never forgets a face.
entities.lived_detail: Dex keeps the noodle pot on a battery that once powered a signal box.
entities.goal: Keep the bunkhouse off every map
entities.current_pressure: Maintenance crews are mapping the dead corridors
entities.next_action: Find a new corridor before the crews reach this one
reaction_conditions: Throws out anyone who brings trouble inside
knowledge_limits: Knows who sleeps where, not why they hide
entities.image_prompt: Cyberpunk RPG concept art for Dex Marlowe. A heavyset bunkhouse keeper stirs a battered noodle pot powered by a salvaged signal-box battery, rows of capsule bunks receding down a dead station corridor that appears on no current map, steam curling in cold blue light.

entities.name: Stim Patch
entities.short_summary: A dermal patch of clotting agents and painkillers that restores health.
entities.description:
A dermal patch of clotting agents and painkillers that restores health.

Station vendors sell them by the strip; the cheap ones itch for an hour, and the expensive ones are counterfeits of the cheap ones.
entities.image_prompt: Cyberpunk RPG item art of a Stim Patch: a translucent dermal patch on a strip of five, threaded with copper-colored clotting gel and a printed dosage band, resting on a wet kiosk counter at Black Rain Station under a buzzing neon fare screen.

entities.name: Ration Bar
entities.short_summary: A dense algae-and-soy bar that eases hunger for a shift.
entities.description:
A dense algae-and-soy bar that eases hunger for a shift.

It tastes of nothing, on purpose: the corporations that print them learned that flavour starts arguments.
entities.image_prompt: Cyberpunk RPG item art of a Ration Bar: a dense green-grey algae-and-soy bar in a crinkled foil sleeve stamped with a corporate shift number, half unwrapped on a stack of faded transit-map wrapping paper beside a dripping station pillar under cold blue platform light.
